definitions.gloss: secretion; the process of secreting substances from cells or glands
definitions.explanation: The biological process by which cells or glands produce and release substances such as hormones, enzymes, sweat, or saliva.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分泌|ぶんぴつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分泌|ぶんぴつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: When saliva secretion decreases, the mouth becomes dry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脳内|のうない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧エンドルフィン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分泌|ぶんぴつ}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that when you exercise, endorphins are secreted in the brain, improving your mood.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (to divide; to separate) and {泌|ぴつ} (to secrete). The character {泌|ぴつ} appears almost exclusively in this word and in {泌尿器|ひにょうき} (urinary organs). Commonly encountered in health articles, biology, and discussions about hormones and skin care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分泌|ぶんぴつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secrete
- {分泌|ぶんぴつ}{物|ぶつ}: secretion (the substance)
- {分泌|ぶんぴつ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of secretion
- ⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分泌|ぶんぴつ}: hormone secretion
- {内分泌|ないぶんぴつ}: endocrine (internal secretion)
- {外分泌|がいぶんぴつ}: exocrine (external secretion)
- ⟦{皮脂|ひし}→皮脂：27786_hishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分泌|ぶんぴつ}: sebum secretion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧: excretion; discharge — removing waste products from the body
- ⟦{放出|ほうしゅつ}→放出：12926_houshutsu⟧: release; emission — a broader term for releasing substances
